finding: PRINTED: 'If a nontoken creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead.' (+Flash, not lane-checkable.) ENGINE(observed): Skyscanner and the second Priest both LAND on the battlefield (zone = battlefield, expected exile). ROOT CAUSE: the ReplacementAbility node compiles correctly (ZoneChangeEvent -> EXILE), but ReplacementRegistry only exposes replacement_for_player_damage / _life_gained / _death hooks - no zone-change hook exists, so the compiled replacement is never consulted.
notes: Printed: 'If a nontoken creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead.' The harness 'enter' op is exactly the not-cast zone change: with Priest #1 already on the battlefield, Skyscanner's entering is REPLACED into exile, and the second Priest exiles itself the same way (CR: the effect applies to OTHER entries; the first Priest entered before its own effect existed, so it survives). 'Flash' is not one of the runner's ten lane-checkable keywords (casting-window legality - probe evidence only, no pack lane).
